```yaml
name: DB Integration Tests

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  db-integration-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:13
        env:
          POSTGRES_DB: testdb
          POSTGRES_USER: testuser
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: testpass
        ports:
          - "5432:5432"
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready -U postgres
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5

      pgbouncer:
        image: bitnami/pgbouncer:1.16
        env:
          PGBouncer_LISTEN_PORT: 6432
          PGBouncer_AUTH_TYPE: md5
          PGBouncer_POOL_MODE: session
          PGBouncer_USERS: "testuser=testpass"
          PGBouncer_DBS: "testdb=postgres"
        ports:
          - "6432:6432"
        depends_on:
          - postgres

      mysql:
        image: mysql:8.0
        env:
          MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: rootpass
          MYSQL_DATABASE: testdb
          MYSQL_USER: testuser
          MYSQL_PASSWORD: testpass
        ports:
          - "3306:3306"
        options: >-
          --health-cmd mysqladmin ping -u root -prootpass
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: go mod download

      - name: Run DB integration tests for PostgreSQL
        run: go test ./... -tags=integration -run=TestPostgresIntegration

      - name: Run DB integration tests for PgBouncer
        run: go test ./... -tags=integration -run=TestPgBouncerIntegration

      - name: Run DB integration tests for MySQL
        run: go test ./... -tags=integration -run=TestMySQLIntegration
```
